preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 2000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 2000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(line) and N >= 2 and N <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2*T+1:2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after T is an integer N (2 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) representing the length of the sequence.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2*T+1:2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains N space-separated integers A_1, ..., A_N (1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9) representing the circular sequence.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [' '.join(map(str, [min_insertions_for_K(A, K) for K in range(2, N+1)])) for A in test_cases]
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains N-1 space-separated integers, where the i-th integer (1 ≤ i ≤ N-1) is the smallest number of inserted elements needed to form a sequence B such that for K = i+1, there is no subsequence B(p, q) of size ≥ K where no two consecutive elements have GCD 1. Here, min_insertions_for_K(A, K) is the minimal insertions required for the given sequence A and K.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N-1 for output_line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line for a test case contains exactly N-1 integers, one for each K from 2 to N.
